# ChartScaleMode

`Flare.Components.ChartScaleMode`

What the plot does when a series is switched off in the legend.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `FitVisible` | `0` | The plot refits to what is left: the value axis is measured from the visible series, its grid lines are recomputed, and a grouped bar chart closes the gap the hidden series left. Every remaining mark moves (the default). |
| `FitAll` | `1` | The plot holds still: the value axis spans every series, hidden ones included, its grid lines stay where the full data put them, and a grouped bar chart keeps each series' slot. Switching a series off then removes that series and nothing else - which is what the reader asked for when they clicked the legend to see the rest without it. |

## Used by components

- `FlareChart`
